description: This file defines the SeriesCollection class, which manages a collection of Series objects within a charting library. It includes methods for cloning the collection, adding new series, and accessing series by index.

classes.name: SeriesCollection
classes.description: A collection class that manages multiple Series objects in a chart.

methods.name: SeriesCollection()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an empty SeriesCollection.

methods.name: SeriesCollection(DocumentObject)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a SeriesCollection with a specified parent object.

methods.name: this[int index]
methods.description: Indexer to get a Series by its index.

methods.name: Clone()
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the SeriesCollection.

methods.name: AddSeries()
methods.description: Creates a new Series object, initializes its chart type based on the parent, adds it to the collection, and returns it.
